svg.title: SoundDesigner — Find it. Shape it. Drop it into the edit.
svg.desc: The supplied cream SoundDesigner wordmark: Sound in SF Pro Display and Designer in Bodoni Moda. A fine blue signal ribbon passes behind the lettering; a small waveform is integrated within Sound. Supports Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, and DaVinci Resolve Studio. All artwork and lettering are vector paths.
